title: LLaVA-Med
paper_title: LLaVA-Med: Training a Large Language-and-Vision Assistant for Biomedicine in One Day
core_mech: 其贡献主要是将 LLaVA 两阶段训练移到生物医学域：PMC 图注概念对齐后再做合成医学指令微调。
core_mech_en: Adapts the LLaVA visual-instruction-tuning paradigm to biomedicine via two-stage training: PMC figure–caption alignment followed by GPT-4-synthesized biomedical instruction tuning.
input_desc: 生物医学图像、图注或用户指令/问题
input_en: Biomedical image + user clinical question or conversational instruction
output_desc: 面向图像的自回归回答、描述与解释文本
output_en: Open-ended autoregressive biomedical explanation, visual QA response, or figure analysis

source.title: LLaVA-Med
